worldcombat.skill.psychup.summary: Matches the target’s stat stages and potion buffs; the target may be a foe or a companion you borrow momentum from. Gains-only mode preserves your own higher stat stages.
worldcombat.skill.psychup.use.0: Snap to the target right after it buffs itself
worldcombat.skill.psychup.use.1: Turn a foe's or companion's boosts into your own
worldcombat.skill.psychup.use.2: Take the target's drops too when mirroring everything
worldcombat.skill.psychup.description.0: Reads a target (foe or companion) within %1$s blocks and clear sight, with a %2$s wind-up. The target must have changed stat stages or a buff to copy.
worldcombat.skill.psychup.description.1: Copied native buffs last at most %1$s, limited by their original remaining duration. Stat stages follow encounter rules. The link icon marks the copy and briefly prevents the companion from recasting it.
worldcombat.skill.psychup.select.0: Gain only: copies only the favourable steps and ignores ones that would weaken you; costs +20 ticks of cooldown and halves the marker.
worldcombat.skill.psychup.select.1: Mirror all: copies every stat change the target has, negatives included; shorter cooldown and a longer marker.
worldcombat.skill.psychup.timing: Range %1$s blocks, %2$s s wind-up, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psychup.growth.0: At level %1$s, base cooldown drops to %2$s; Speed and configuration still adjust the actual cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psychup.growth.1: At level %1$s, base cooldown drops to %2$s; Speed and configuration still adjust the actual cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psychup.preference.sel: On = gain only: copies only the favourable steps and ignores negatives, at +20 ticks cooldown and half the marker. Off = mirror all: copies every step (negatives included) with a shorter cooldown and longer marker.
The move is considered only when the threat is within this distance; larger means reading from farther away, smaller means only at close range.
On: a holding companion will leave its post to read the target. Off: it casts only where it already stands.
